title: The Autograd Overhead Lives in Backward
subtitle: MNIST MLP at batch 128, single-threaded, minimum over 320 steps
caption: The hand-written NumPy network does the same math with no graph and reuses smolgrad's AdamW. smolgrad minus NumPy is the cost of the autograd machinery, and NumPy minus PyTorch is the cost of the kernels. Taken under a load average near 340, so these are upper bounds.
source: the project's single-thread benchmark, MLP at batch 128, minimum times
